title: 第21章 吞噬之体第22章 藏书阁
slug: 大千世界今日吾逍遥也
content_zh:
朔衡的语气轻松惬意，让朔千夜也不自主的放松警惕。
直到，朔千夜看到了一个之前并不认识的人从阴影里走出来。
但似乎也有些印象，是青松峰峰主亲传，那位火系圣灵根的陆纵横。
而躺在陆纵横脚边的，是一具尸体。
朔千夜立刻把朔衡挡在身后。
他看得很清楚，那位躺在地上了无生息的仙门弟子系在腰间的玉碟，正是蓝底青纹。
这种颜色，是青松峰内门弟子的标志。
“陆纵横师弟，你对他做了什么？”朔千夜神色有些冷，但一向温文尔雅的性子让他的语气显得依旧温和。
陆纵横大概没想到会有人大晚上来这么偏僻的地方，但他的神色只是带着些惊讶，并没有慌乱：“没做什么。”
朔千夜皱着眉，正想拔出剑来，却被朔衡摁住了手。
“大哥，别急。”朔衡笑了笑，“好歹让人说说发生了什么，我看他好像没什么动手的打算。”
陆纵横闻言，暗自松了口气。
朔千夜早已筑基，关于这位宫主亲传的事迹，陆纵横早有耳闻。
自己现在的修为比不上他，而且当朔千夜想要拔剑的那一刻，陆纵横只觉得危险无比。
身为气运之子，越阶战斗已是常态。
可惜对象若是另一个气运之子，似乎就不能跟寻常情况一概而论了。
“我来的时候，他就已经死了，我刚刚只是在查看他的伤口。身为青松峰峰主亲传，我有这样的权力。”
朔衡挑挑眉，察觉到陆纵横话语中的一丝丝迟疑，心中有了猜测。
没记错的话，这小子是吞噬之体吧？
难道能吞噬死人的修为，或是灵根？

亦或是……根骨？
“那为何要选在这样偏僻的角落？”
陆纵横摇摇头：“不是我选的，是他原本的尸体就在这儿。”
朔千夜皱皱眉：“师弟说自己不是凶手，但身为目击者，便跟我们回一趟执法队大堂吧，想必执法队定有办法还你清白。”
陆纵横沉默了一下，点点头。
在阴暗的旮旯里，他跟一个尸体凑在一起，惹人怀疑确实没什么可说的。
“大哥，你们两个去执法队吧，我就在这儿守着。”朔衡对两人笑笑，“这证据可要保护好了，方便一会儿来人探查。”
朔千夜有些担心：“小衡，这里给我的感觉有些不妙，不如还是我……”
“没事的，大哥，你忘了家里给了我那么多保命的东西吗？”朔衡摆摆手，“不说别的，我的小命肯定是有保障的，你们快去吧。”
朔千夜点点头，没再多说什么，带着陆纵横御剑离开。
朔衡目送两人飞远，嘴角的笑意渐渐消失。
他走到尸体旁边，将尸体翻了过来。
是个很面生的人，倒也正常，毕竟苍澜仙宫的内门弟子很多，他不可能每一个都记得。
只是……这人的脖子上似乎有一个小黑点？
不仔细看都看不出来。
【小四，检查一下这个小黑点是什么。】
【叮，正在检测。
content_en:
Shuo Heng's tone was relaxed and pleasant, which made Shuo Qianye involuntarily relax his vigilance.
Until, Shuo Qianye saw a person he didn't know before walking out of the shadows.
But there seems to be some impression that it was Lu Zongheng who was personally taught by the master of Qingsong Peak, the fire-based Holy Spirit.
And lying at Lu Zongheng's feet was a corpse.
Shuo Qianye immediately blocked Shuo Heng behind him.
He could clearly see that the jade plate tied to the waist of the immortal disciple who was lying lifeless on the ground was exactly the same with blue patterns on the background.
This color is the symbol of the inner disciples of Qingsong Peak.
"Junior Brother Lu Zongheng, what did you do to him?" Shuo Qianye looked a little cold, but his always gentle temper made his tone still gentle.
Lu Zongheng probably didn't expect that someone would come to such a remote place at night, but his expression was just a little surprised, not panicked: "I didn't do anything."
Shuo Qianye frowned and was about to pull out his sword, but Shuo Heng held his hand down.
"Brother, don't worry." Shuo Heng smiled, "At least let someone tell you what happened. I don't think he has any plans to do anything."
Hearing this, Lu Zongheng secretly breathed a sigh of relief.
Shuo Qianye had already laid the foundation, and Lu Zongheng had already heard about the palace master’s personal deeds.
His current cultivation level was not comparable to his, and the moment Shuo Qianye wanted to draw his sword, Lu Zongheng felt extremely dangerous.
As a child of destiny, fighting across ranks is the norm.
Unfortunately, if the target is another child of luck, it seems that it cannot be generalized to the ordinary situation.
"He was already dead when I came. I was just checking his wounds. As the direct descendant of the Qingsong Peak Master, I have such power."
Shuo Heng raised his eyebrows, noticing a trace of hesitation in Lu Zongheng's words, and he had a guess in his mind.
If I remember correctly, this kid is a devouring body, right?
Can it swallow the cultivation base or spiritual roots of the dead?
Or... the root bone?
"Then why choose such a remote corner?"
Lu Zongheng shook his head: "I didn't choose it, his original body is right here."
Shuo Qianye frowned: "Junior brother said that he is not the murderer, but as a witness, come with us back to the lobby of the law enforcement team. I believe the law enforcement team will have a way to clear your name."
Lu Zongheng was silent for a moment and nodded.
In a dark corner, he was together with a corpse, making people suspicious that there really was nothing to say.
"Brother, you two go to the law enforcement team, I will guard here." Shuo Heng smiled at the two of them, "This evidence must be protected so that someone can come and investigate later."
Shuo Qianye was a little worried: "Xiao Heng, I feel a little bad here, why don't I..."
"It's okay, brother, have you forgotten that my family has given me so many life-saving things?" Shuo Heng waved his hand, "If nothing else, my life is definitely guaranteed, so go ahead."
Shuo Qianye nodded, said nothing more, and left with Lu Zongheng's sword.
Shuo Heng watched the two of them fly away, and the smile on his lips gradually disappeared.
He walked over to the body and turned it over.
He is a very face-to-face person, which is normal. After all, there are many inner disciples in Canglan Immortal Palace, and it is impossible for him to remember every one of them.
It's just...this man seems to have a small black spot on his neck?
You can't tell it unless you look carefully.
[Xiao Si, check what this little black dot is. 】
[Ding, testing is in progress.
